The change has one problem. `today()` calls `SystemTime::now()` directly inside a command, which breaks the `clock` rule. I did not open any files to check this; it comes from the diff and the steering text alone.

The tests only avoid the real date by using far-future days (2099, 2999). The past-day rule can't be tested against a fixed date, and those test dates will quietly become wrong if the clock moves past them.
